You can work full-time or part-time.
sentences.Heltid betyr at du jobber 100 prosent, m: Full-time means that you work 100 per cent, while part-time means that you work less than 100 per cent.
sentences.Hvis du jobber heltid, er normal arbeids: If you work full-time, normal working hours are 37.5 hours a week.
sentences.Du jobber overtid hvis du jobber mer enn: You work overtime if you work more than what it says in your contract.
sentences.Hvis du har fast jobb, har du jobben på: If you have a permanent job, you have the job for an unlimited period.
sentences.Hvis du har midlertidig jobb, er du kans: If you have a temporary job, you may be covering for someone who is ill or someone who is on leave.
sentences.Mange begynner i en midlertidig stilling: Many people start in a temporary position and gradually get a permanent job.
sentences.Alle som har jobb i Norge, skal ha en sk: Everyone who has a job in Norway should have a written employment contract.
sentences.Der skal det blant annet stå noe om lønn: Among other things, it should say something about pay and working hours.
sentences.Det er vanlig å få lønn en gang i månede: It is common to be paid once a month.
A certain percentage of your pay is tax.
sentences.Normal skatt av lønn i Norge er ca. 30 p: Normal tax on pay in Norway is about 30 per cent.
sentences.Hvis du har høy lønn, betaler du mer ska: If you have high pay, you pay more tax than if you have low pay.
sentences.Du betaler ikke skatt hvis du tjener min: You don't pay tax if you earn less than 50,000 kroner a year.
sentences.Sjefen din bestemmer over deg i arbeidst: Your boss decides over you during your working hours.
sentences.Det betyr at du må møte presis hver dag: That means that you must turn up on time every day and let people know if you can't come to work one day.
sentences.Du har plikt til å levere permisjonssøkn: You have a duty to hand in an application for leave if you know that you have to be away from work.
sentences.Hvis du må gå til lege eller tannlege i: If you have to go to the doctor or dentist during working hours, you must apply for leave in advance.
sentences.Hvis du ikke er medlem i Den norske kirk: If you are not a member of the Church of Norway, you can get two days of unpaid leave every year to celebrate holidays in other religions.
sentences.Hvis du har vært syk, må du fylle ut et: If you have been ill, you must fill in a self-certification form when you come back to work.
sentences.Du må også levere egenmelding hvis du ha: You must also hand in a self-certification if you have been at home with sick children.
sentences.Spør sjefen din om reglene for egenmeldi: Ask your boss about the rules for self-certification at your workplace.
sentences.Hvis du er syk mer enn tre dager, må du: If you are ill for more than three days, you must get a sick note from a doctor.
sentences.Du kan få sykemelding av legen hvis lege: You can get a sick note from the doctor if the doctor thinks that you need it.
